versos.hebraico: ה֣וֹי שׁוֹדֵ֗ד וְאַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א שָׁד֔וּד וּבוֹגֵ֖ד וְלֹא־בָ֣גְדוּ ב֑וֹ כַּהֲתִֽמְךָ֤ שׁוֹדֵד֙ תּוּשַּׁ֔ד כַּנְּלֹתְךָ֥ לִבְגֹּ֖ד יִבְגְּדוּ־בָֽךְ׃ס

controles.web: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed; and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have made an end of betrayal, you will be betrayed.
controles.kjv: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
controles.livre: Ai de ti, assolador, que não foste assolado, e que enganas sem ter sido enganado! Quando terminares de assolar, tu é que serás assolado; quando terminares de enganar, então te enganarão.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֥ה חָנֵּ֖נוּ לְךָ֣ קִוִּ֑ינוּ הֱיֵ֤ה זְרֹעָם֙ לַבְּקָרִ֔ים אַף־יְשׁוּעָתֵ֖נוּ בְּעֵ֥ת צָרָֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
controles.kjv: O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
controles.livre: Ó SENHOR, tem misericórdia de nós! Em ti temos esperança. Que tu sejas nossa força nas madrugadas, e nossa salvação no tempo de aflição.

versos.hebraico: מִקּ֣וֹל הָמ֔וֹן נָדְד֖וּ עַמִּ֑ים מֵר֣וֹמְמֻתֶ֔ךָ נָפְצ֖וּ גּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
controles.kjv: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
controles.livre: Ao som do ruído estrondoso, fugirão; quando tu te levantas, as nações se dispersam.

versos.hebraico: וְאֻסַּ֣ף שְׁלַלְכֶ֔ם אֹ֖סֶף הֶֽחָסִ֑יל כְּמַשַּׁ֥ק גֵּבִ֖ים שׁוֹקֵ֥ק בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.
controles.kjv: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
controles.livre: Então, nações ,vossos despojos serão colhidos tal como os insetos colhem; tal como os gafanhotos saltam, assim saltarão.

versos.hebraico: נִשְׂגָּ֣ב יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י שֹׁכֵ֖ן מָר֑וֹם מִלֵּ֣א צִיּ֔וֹן מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
controles.kjv: The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
controles.livre: Exaltado é o SENHOR, pois habita nas alturas; ele encheu a Sião de juízo e justiça.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָה֙ אֱמוּנַ֣ת עִתֶּ֔יךָ חֹ֥סֶן יְשׁוּעֹ֖ת חָכְמַ֣ת וָדָ֑עַת יִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה הִ֥יא אוֹצָרֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.
controles.kjv: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the Lord is his treasure.
controles.livre: Ele é a segurança de teus tempos, e a fonte de tua salvação, sabedoria e conhecimento; o temor ao SENHOR é seu tesouro.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֚ן אֶרְאֶלָּ֔ם צָעֲק֖וּ חֻ֑צָה מַלְאֲכֵ֣י שָׁל֔וֹם מַ֖ר יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃

controles.web: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
controles.kjv: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
controles.livre: Eis que os embaixadores deles estão gritando de fora; os mensageiros de paz estão chorando amargamente.

versos.hebraico: נָשַׁ֣מּוּ מְסִלּ֔וֹת שָׁבַ֖ת עֹבֵ֣ר אֹ֑רַח הֵפֵ֤ר בְּרִית֙ מָאַ֣ס עָרִ֔ים לֹ֥א חָשַׁ֖ב אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
controles.kjv: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
controles.livre: As estradas estão vazias, não há quem passe pelos caminhos; o pacto foi desfeito, cidades foram desprezadas, ninguém é considerado importante.

versos.hebraico: אָבַ֤ל אֻמְלְלָה֙ אָ֔רֶץ הֶחְפִּ֥יר לְבָנ֖וֹן קָמַ֑ל הָיָ֤ה הַשָּׁרוֹן֙ כָּֽעֲרָבָ֔ה וְנֹעֵ֥ר בָּשָׁ֖ן וְכַרְמֶֽל׃

controles.web: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.
controles.kjv: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
controles.livre: A terra lamenta e se definha; o Líbano se envergonha e se seca; Sarom se tornou com um deserto; e Basã e Carmelo foram sacudidos, tiradas suas folhas .

versos.hebraico: עַתָּ֥ה אָק֖וּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ אֵֽרוֹמָ֔ם עַתָּ֖ה אֶנָּשֵֽׂא׃

controles.web: “Now I will arise,” says Yahweh; “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.
controles.kjv: Now will I rise, saith the Lord; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
controles.livre: Agora eu me levantarei,diz o SENHOR; agora me elevarei; agora serei exaltado.

versos.hebraico: תַּהֲר֥וּ חֲשַׁ֖שׁ תֵּ֣לְדוּ קַ֑שׁ רוּחֲכֶ֕ם אֵ֖שׁ תֹּאכַלְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.
controles.kjv: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
controles.livre: Concebestes palha, gerais restos de cascas; vosso sopro vos consumirá como o fogo.

versos.hebraico: וְהָי֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת שִׂ֑יד קוֹצִ֥ים כְּסוּחִ֖ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יִצַּֽתּוּ׃ס

controles.web: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
controles.kjv: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
controles.livre: E os povos serão como incêndios de cal; tal como espinhos cortados, eles se queimarão no fogo.

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֥וּ רְחוֹקִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וּדְע֥וּ קְרוֹבִ֖ים גְּבֻרָתִֽי׃

controles.web: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”
controles.kjv: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
controles.livre: Vós que estais longe, ouvi o que eu tenho feito; e vós que estais perto, conhecei o meu poder.

versos.hebraico: פָּחֲד֤וּ בְצִיּוֹן֙ חַטָּאִ֔ים אָחֲזָ֥ה רְעָדָ֖ה חֲנֵפִ֑ים מִ֣י׀ יָג֣וּר לָ֗נוּ אֵ֚שׁ אוֹכֵלָ֔ה מִי־יָג֥וּר לָ֖נוּ מוֹקְדֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
controles.kjv: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
controles.livre: Os pecadores em Sião estão assombrados; o tremor tomou os perversos; eles dizem : Quem dentre nós pode conviver  com o fogo consumidor? Quem dentre nós pode conviver com as labaredas eternas?

versos.hebraico: הֹלֵ֣ךְ צְדָק֔וֹת וְדֹבֵ֖ר מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים מֹאֵ֞ס בְּבֶ֣צַע מַעֲשַׁקּ֗וֹת נֹעֵ֤ר כַּפָּיו֙ מִתְּמֹ֣ךְ בַּשֹּׁ֔חַד אֹטֵ֤ם אָזְנוֹ֙ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ דָּמִ֔ים וְעֹצֵ֥ם עֵינָ֖יו מֵרְא֥וֹת בְּרָֽע׃

controles.web: He who walks righteously, and speaks blamelessly; He who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—
controles.kjv: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
controles.livre: O que anda em justiça, e que fala o que é correto; que rejeita o ganho proveniente de opressões, que com suas mãos faz o gesto de “não” aos subornos, que tapa seus ouvidos para não ouvir sobre crimes de sangue, e fecha seus olhos para não ver o mal.

versos.hebraico: ה֚וּא מְרוֹמִ֣ים יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן מְצָד֥וֹת סְלָעִ֖ים מִשְׂגַּבּ֑וֹ לַחְמ֣וֹ נִתָּ֔ן מֵימָ֖יו נֶאֱמָנִֽים׃

controles.web: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.
controles.kjv: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
controles.livre: Este morará nas alturas; fortalezas de rochas serão seu abrigo; ele será provido de pão, e suas águas serão garantidas.

versos.hebraico: מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּיָפְי֖וֹ תֶּחֱזֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֑יךָ תִּרְאֶ֖ינָה אֶ֥רֶץ מַרְחַקִּֽים׃

controles.web: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.
controles.kjv: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
controles.livre: Teus olhos verão o rei em sua formosura; e verão uma terra que se estende até longe.

versos.hebraico: לִבְּךָ֖ יֶהְגֶּ֣ה אֵימָ֑ה אַיֵּ֤ה סֹפֵר֙ אַיֵּ֣ה שֹׁקֵ֔ל אַיֵּ֖ה סֹפֵ֥ר אֶת־הַמִּגְדָּלִֽים׃

controles.web: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?
controles.kjv: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
controles.livre: Teu coração pensará sobre o assombro, dizendo: Onde está o escriba? Onde está o tesoureiro?  Onde está o que contava as torres?

versos.hebraico: אֶת־עַ֥ם נוֹעָ֖ז לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה עַ֣ם עִמְקֵ֤י שָׂפָה֙ מִשְּׁמ֔וֹעַ נִלְעַ֥ג לָשׁ֖וֹן אֵ֥ין בִּינָֽה׃

controles.web: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
controles.livre: Não verás mais aquele povo atrevido, povo de fala tão profunda, que não se pode compreender, de língua tão estranha, que não se pode entender.

versos.hebraico: חֲזֵ֣ה צִיּ֔וֹן קִרְיַ֖ת מֽוֹעֲדֵ֑נוּ עֵינֶיךָ֩ תִרְאֶ֨ינָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם נָוֶ֣ה שַׁאֲנָ֗ן אֹ֤הֶל בַּל־יִצְעָן֙ בַּל־יִסַּ֤ע יְתֵֽדֹתָיו֙ לָנֶ֔צַח וְכָל־חֲבָלָ֖יו בַּל־יִנָּתֵֽקוּ׃

controles.web: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
controles.kjv: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
controles.livre: Olhai para Sião, a cidade de nossas solenidades; teus olhos verão Jerusalém, morada tranquila, tenda que não será derrubada, cujas estacas nunca serão arrancadas, e nenhuma de suas cordas se arrebentará.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י אִם־שָׁ֞ם אַדִּ֤יר יְהוָה֙ לָ֔נוּ מְקוֹם־נְהָרִ֥ים יְאֹרִ֖ים רַחֲבֵ֣י יָדָ֑יִם בַּל־תֵּ֤לֶךְ בּוֹ֙ אֳנִי־שַׁ֔יִט וְצִ֥י אַדִּ֖יר לֹ֥א יַעַבְרֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of broad rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.
controles.kjv: But there the glorious Lord will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
controles.livre: Mas ali o SENHOR será grandioso para nós: ele será um lugar de rios e correntes largas; nenhum barco a remo passará por eles, nem navio grande navegará por eles.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֔נוּ יְהוָ֖ה מְחֹקְקֵ֑נוּ יְהוָ֥ה מַלְכֵּ֖נוּ ה֥וּא יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃

controles.web: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.
controles.kjv: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.
controles.livre: Pois o SENHOR é nosso juiz; o SENHOR é nosso legislador; o SENHOR é nosso Rei, ele nos salvará.

versos.hebraico: נִטְּשׁ֖וּ חֲבָלָ֑יִךְ בַּל־יְחַזְּק֤וּ כֵן־תָּרְנָם֙ בַּל־פָּ֣רְשׂוּ נֵ֔ס אָ֣ז חֻלַּ֤ק עַֽד־שָׁלָל֙ מַרְבֶּ֔ה פִּסְחִ֖ים בָּ֥זְזוּ בַֽז׃

controles.web: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.
controles.kjv: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
controles.livre: Tuas cordas se afrouxaram; não puderam manter firme o seu mastro, nem estenderam a vela; então uma grande quantidade de despojos  será repartida; até os aleijados tomarão despojos.

versos.hebraico: וּבַל־יֹאמַ֥ר שָׁכֵ֖ן חָלִ֑יתִי הָעָ֛ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּ֖הּ נְשֻׂ֥א עָוֺֽן׃

controles.web: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
controles.kjv: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
controles.livre: E nenhum morador dirá: Estou enfermo; porque o povo que nela habitar será perdoado de sua perversidade.
